dialogues.jp: 「早くしろよ音夢！」
dialogues.en: Time has passed since then.
dialogues.text: Time has passed since then.

dialogues.jp: 携帯で時間を確認しつつ、家の中に声をかける。
dialogues.en:
After the cherry tree died, I don't have other people's
dreams any more, and Nemu got much better.
dialogues.text:
After the cherry tree died, I don't have other people's
dreams any more, and Nemu got much better.

dialogues.jp: 例の看護師になるための進学。

一時は俺と一緒に本校に進学すると言っていた
音夢だが、入院がやる気と、看護師さんの制服
の可愛さでも再認識させたのだろう。
dialogues.en: If you ask me what changed, that's it.
dialogues.text: If you ask me what changed, that's it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、兄さん兄さん。私のパジャマ用にシャツ
　何枚か持っていってもいい？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh no. Do you have the permission slip from the doctor,
niisan?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh no. Do you have the permission slip from the doctor,
niisan?"

dialogues.jp:
ため息を５月の空に吐き出した……まぁ、万年
五月病みたいなもんだけどさ。
dialogues.en:
"No, I don't... You have to important things like that
yourself!"
dialogues.text:
"No, I don't... You have to important things like that
yourself!"

dialogues.en: "Is she a little self-conscious about us?"
dialogues.text: "Is she a little self-conscious about us?"

dialogues.jp: あれから少しだけ時間が経った。
dialogues.en: I hear laughter like a bell from behind me.
dialogues.text: I hear laughter like a bell from behind me.

dialogues.jp:
桜の木が１本だけ枯れて、俺が他人の夢を見な
くなって、音夢の体調が快方に向かった。
dialogues.en: "Are you ready yourself?"
dialogues.text: "Are you ready yourself?"

dialogues.en: I call to my sweetheart who suddenly came back.
dialogues.text: I call to my sweetheart who suddenly came back.

dialogues.jp: 変化といったら、まぁ、それくらいだろうか？
dialogues.en: "Is it a witch's broom?"
dialogues.text: "Is it a witch's broom?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクたちに気を遣ってるんじゃないかな？」
dialogues.en: "And a cloak... They are my grandma's keepsakes."
dialogues.text: "And a cloak... They are my grandma's keepsakes."

dialogues.jp:
背中から、鈴を鳴らしたような笑い声が飛び込
んでくる。
dialogues.en: "Holy shit..."
dialogues.text: "Holy shit..."

dialogues.jp: 「……そっちの準備は終わったのか？」
dialogues.en: Sakura looks absolutely like a witch and nothing else.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks absolutely like a witch and nothing else.

dialogues.jp:
いつの間にか戻ってきたらしい、恋人に声をか
ける。
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you want to go?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you want to go?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃじゃ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. I left without finishing the research I was doing.
They must've been very mad at me, so I'm ready to pay the
price."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. I left without finishing the research I was doing.
They must've been very mad at me, so I'm ready to pay the
price."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ホウキ？」
dialogues.en: Sakura laughs while scratching her cheek.
dialogues.text: Sakura laughs while scratching her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それとマント……これがおばあちゃんの形見
　の品でした♪」
dialogues.en:
"As long as I live on this island, there was no way to find
me."
dialogues.text:
"As long as I live on this island, there was no way to find
me."

dialogues.jp:
今のさくらの姿といったら、魔法使い以外の何
者でもない。
dialogues.en: "When can you come back?"
dialogues.text: "When can you come back?"

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、本当に行くのか？」
dialogues.en: I tilt my head while scratching my nose.
dialogues.text: I tilt my head while scratching my nose.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。あっちでやってた研究、全部すっぽか
　してこっち来ちゃったからね……いっぱい怒
　られてこなきゃ」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... I think I'll be back next summer. We promised,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... I think I'll be back next summer. We promised,
right?"

dialogues.jp: てへへへ、と頬をかいてさくらが笑う。
dialogues.en: "Yeah, the ocean."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, the ocean."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「この島にいるうちは、見つからないようになっ
　てたんだけどね」
dialogues.en: "And, I'll wear a bathing suit from school, right?"
dialogues.text: "And, I'll wear a bathing suit from school, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「今度はいつ来られる？」
dialogues.en: "Sorry about that..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry about that..."

dialogues.jp: 鼻の頭をかいて首を傾ける。
dialogues.en: I throw up my hands.
dialogues.text: I throw up my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ〜……来年の夏には来られると思うよ。
　約束したからね」
dialogues.en: "Hrmph! I'll be back as a mature lady next time."
dialogues.text: "Hrmph! I'll be back as a mature lady next time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「海な」
dialogues.en: "I look forward to it eagerly, but fearfully."
dialogues.text: "I look forward to it eagerly, but fearfully."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「スクール水着でね」
dialogues.en: "Hm, what does that mean?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, what does that mean?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらのスクール水着姿を想像して、少しにや
けた。
dialogues.en: "Well, it means just what I said."
dialogues.text: "Well, it means just what I said."

dialogues.jp:
俺の表情の移り変わりを察してか、さくらはぷぅ
とむくれて、宣言した。
dialogues.en: I narrow my eyes after giving an evasive answer.
dialogues.text: I narrow my eyes after giving an evasive answer.

dialogues.jp:
「いくぶん嬉しく、いくぶん寂しく期待してる
　よ」
dialogues.en: "I wanted to kiss you every day."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to kiss you every day."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、なにそれ？」
dialogues.en: "I know... It's a shame."
dialogues.text: "I know... It's a shame."

dialogues.jp: むにゃむにゃ、と言葉を濁して目を細める。
dialogues.en: We look at each other, thinking about our future.
dialogues.text: We look at each other, thinking about our future.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、毎日キスしてやるって言ったのにな」
dialogues.en: "Do you need to charge again?"
dialogues.text: "Do you need to charge again?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……うにゃ、それが残念だね」
dialogues.en: "I think I'm all right."
dialogues.text: "I think I'm all right."

dialogues.jp:
ふたりの視線が絡み合い、さまざまな未来を映
す。
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 「充電必要かな？」
dialogues.en:
I'm the one that actually needed it, and I thought if I hug
her now, I might find it too hard to say goodbye to her, so
I didn't.
dialogues.text:
I'm the one that actually needed it, and I thought if I hug
her now, I might find it too hard to say goodbye to her, so
I didn't.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫……だと思う」
dialogues.en:
"Come to think of it, what kind of promise did you make with
me six years ago?"
dialogues.text:
"Come to think of it, what kind of promise did you make with
me six years ago?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと、自分のほうに足りない気がしたけれ
ど、ここで抱きしめてしまうと後で辛そうなの
で止めた。
dialogues.en: "Is it anything that Nemu would get mad about?"
dialogues.text: "Is it anything that Nemu would get mad about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Ohh!"
dialogues.text: "Ohh!"

dialogues.jp: くすくす、とさくらが微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura chuckles.
dialogues.text: Sakura chuckles.

dialogues.jp: 本当に裏表のない笑顔だ。
dialogues.en: Her smile is pure innocence.
dialogues.text: Her smile is pure innocence.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ♪　女の子だけの秘密だよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Hmm! It's a girl's secret."
dialogues.text: "Hmm! It's a girl's secret."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そないか」
dialogues.en: "Really."
dialogues.text: "Really."

dialogues.jp: まぁ、つまるところ、ろくでもないってことだ。
dialogues.en: That means it must be something bad.
dialogues.text: That means it must be something bad.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……お別れだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, this is it."
dialogues.text: "Well, this is it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイだよ」
dialogues.en: "This is it."
dialogues.text: "This is it."

dialogues.jp: 終わりにしては素っ気無い挨拶だった。
dialogues.en: It was a brief good-bye as a farewell.
dialogues.text: It was a brief good-bye as a farewell.

dialogues.jp:
多分、また始まることを知っているからだと思
う。
dialogues.en: Because we know we will see each other in the future.
dialogues.text: Because we know we will see each other in the future.

dialogues.jp: 今度は――自分達の意思で巡り会えますように。
dialogues.en:
Next time, I hope we'll have a chance meeting by our own
wills.
dialogues.text:
Next time, I hope we'll have a chance meeting by our own
wills.

dialogues.jp:
巡り会い――一緒にずっと歩んでいけますよう
に。
dialogues.en:
A chance meeting... I hope we keep on walking together
forever.
dialogues.text:
A chance meeting... I hope we keep on walking together
forever.

dialogues.jp:
小さく手を振りながら、さくらの目じりにひっ
そりと水たまりが生まれる。
dialogues.en:
I see tears welling up in her eyes as she slowly waves her
hand.
dialogues.text:
I see tears welling up in her eyes as she slowly waves her
hand.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ、お兄ちゃん……うんん」
dialogues.en: "Good bye, oniichan... no..."
dialogues.text: "Good bye, oniichan... no..."

dialogues.jp:
世界で一番きれいな水をぬぐって、さくらが笑
う。
dialogues.en:
Sakura wipes away the most pure water in the world, and
smiles.
dialogues.text:
Sakura wipes away the most pure water in the world, and
smiles.

dialogues.jp: とろけそうな笑みを。
dialogues.en: The sweetest smile.
dialogues.text: The sweetest smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「また会おうね」
dialogues.en: "See you again, Junichi-kun!"
dialogues.text: "See you again, Junichi-kun!"

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・また会おうね◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
あれから、少しだけ時間が経った。音夢は看護
学校進学のため、今日旅立つというのに、未だ
に支度に手間取っていやがる。
dialogues.en:
Checking the time on my cell phone, I call into the house to
her.
dialogues.text:
Checking the time on my cell phone, I call into the house to
her.

dialogues.jp:
ったく、これでほんとに一人でやっていけるの
か、本気で心配になる。音夢に言わせれば、俺
の方が心配なのだろうが……。
dialogues.en: "Okay, hang on, I'm coming!"
dialogues.text: "Okay, hang on, I'm coming!"

dialogues.jp: そしてもう一人――
dialogues.en: "I can wait for you patiently, but the express bus can't."
dialogues.text: "I can wait for you patiently, but the express bus can't."

dialogues.jp: ｛こいつ／恋人｝とも、しばしのお別れだ。
dialogues.en: She's going to a new school to become a nurse.
dialogues.text: She's going to a new school to become a nurse.

dialogues.jp:
アメリカでの研究を、全部ほっぽり出して、初
音島へ来たらしい。いよいよ、腹を括ったとい
うことかな。
dialogues.en:
She said she would go to the same school as me, but after
her hospitalization, a nurse's cute uniform might have
changed her mind, or she might have been inspired by them.
dialogues.text:
She said she would go to the same school as me, but after
her hospitalization, a nurse's cute uniform might have
changed her mind, or she might have been inspired by them.

dialogues.jp:
互いに一区切りをつけ、これまでの関係に終わ
りを、そして新たな関係の始まりを――
dialogues.en: She decided to go to nursing school.
dialogues.text: She decided to go to nursing school.

dialogues.jp:
そんな、ダ・カーポのような終わりと始まりの
交差点が、現在という時なんだと思う。
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan. Cam I have a few shirts of yours for pajamas?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan. Cam I have a few shirts of yours for pajamas?"

dialogues.jp: 「お別れだな」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you buy brand new ones over there?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you buy brand new ones over there?"

dialogues.jp: 「バイバイだよ」
dialogues.en: "I don't think so!"
dialogues.text: "I don't think so!"

dialogues.jp:
再び出会うことを知っているから、別れの言葉
は簡素で、半ば投げやりだ。次に会えるのは、
来年の夏らしい。
dialogues.en: "Come on! What are you doing to take so long?"
dialogues.text: "Come on! What are you doing to take so long?"

dialogues.jp: 「また会おうね」
dialogues.en: I sigh at the May sky. Well, it's kind of a spring fever.
dialogues.text: I sigh at the May sky. Well, it's kind of a spring fever.

dialogues.jp: 目尻にたまった、涙を拭って、さくらは笑った。
